subject: Crestline: confirmation and schedule for prompt/output/log removal
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@crestlinemedia.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Remove prompts/outputs/logs for org crestline-9 (data residency/us)

Hi Lauren / Ben,

Per our data-retention policy conformance and the customer's request, Crestline would like Redwood to execute an erasure for artifacts associated with org id crestline-9. Scope: all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and ephemeral KV logs tied to crestline-9 since 2023-11-01. This is a full sweep request (no partial date ranges).

Deliverables we need:
- Confirmation when erasure starts and completes (timestamps)
- A small, downloadable manifest listing file identifiers that were removed (blank when content is streaming-only is acceptable, but we need an assertion of scope)
- Signed attestation that logs supporting inference (trace/log buckets) were removed per Redwood's retention schedule
- Any exceptions or records retained for legal hold (none expected)

We attached a CSV with the organization identifiers and the primary contact. We are aiming for the operation to occur before May 29th to meet their compliance window. Can you confirm the expected timeline and any required approvals or paperwork (DPA addendum, PO, etc.)?

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Data Privacy Lead
Crestline Media

Attachments: crestline_deletion_scope_20250521.csv (csv)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@crestlinemedia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Remove prompts/outputs/logs for org crestline-9 (data residency/us)

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear scope and the CSV. We can run a targeted erasure for crestline-9. High-level process and ask:

1) Scope verification (today) — we confirm identifiers in your CSV map to the runtime artifacts we hold.
2) Scheduling window (you requested before May 29) — ops prefer the job to run in a two-hour maintenance window to ensure logs / KV caches are drained cleanly. Windows available: May 26 02:00–04:00 PT or May 28 23:00–01:00 PT. Please confirm your preferred window.
3) Paperwork — standard DPA addendum already in place for Crestline. For this sweep we only need written acceptance of the deletion scope (a reply to this thread is sufficient). If you need a formal attestation PDF and manifest, we provide after completion.
4) Artifacts and outputs delivered — post-job we deliver: a deletion_manifest_template.csv (populated), timestamps, runbook reference, and an audit trace link. Note: for streaming-only tokens we provide an assertion rather than object-level manifests per protocol.

I've attached our runbook and the blank manifest template so your compliance team can preview. Ben, can you confirm estimated duration and whether any special handling is required for legacy KV shards?

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_erasure_runbook_v2.pdf (pdf), deletion_manifest_template.csv (csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@crestlinemedia.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 01:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Remove prompts/outputs/logs for org crestline-9 (data residency/us)

Claire / Lauren — technical notes and schedule recommendation.

- I verified the CSV mapping to runtime identifiers; crestline-9 has 3 active GPU-serving prefixes and two K/V shard groups that can be quiesced. Total estimated objects to mark for purge: ~42k prompt-output records + ~18k ephemeral trace entries.
- Erasure strategy: staged delete (prefix tombstone -> kv sweep -> audit manifest generation). We expect the job to complete within the 2-hour window once initiated, assuming no backlog in the async sweep queue.
- Edge cases: there are a handful (~12) of held audit logs in our long-term archival store (S3 Glacier-style) flagged as legal-hold eligible. I don't see an active legal hold on Crestline's account, but if any legal preservation is later required we will preserve copies and mark them in the attestation as retained with rationale.

Recommended window: May 26 02:00–04:00 PT (lower traffic). I will coordinate with Ops to place a maintenance marker and disable autoscale on the dedicated pool for the two hours to minimize mutation during the sweep.

On completion we will:
- Upload populated deletion_manifest_crestline-20250526.csv to a secure link
- Generate a brief PDF attestation with timestamps and job ids
- Provide an audit trace link (read-only) and the runbook excerpt for the executed steps

Let me know if you need the attestation to include a certificate signature (we can sign the PDF with our internal key) or if a standard signed letter is fine.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren / Ben — May 26 02:00–04:00 PT works for Crestline. We accept the scope as listed in our CSV and we do not have any active legal hold. Please proceed and provide the signed attestation PDF after completion. We also prefer a signed PDF with certificate signature if available.

One small ask: can you include a short line in the attestation that references our region (US) and confirms no replication to EU/APAC buckets exists for these artifacts? That's needed for our internal compliance checklist.

Claire
